<br>

:::{.justify}
As 2025 draws to a close, so does my second year as Editor. I would like to once again thank everyone who contributes to the Bulletin and makes this publication possible.

This issue opens with a beautiful obituary in memory of Harry van Zanten, followed by updates from the Program Council, Bayesian Analysis, and the Prize Committee. Be sure not to miss the report from the Ad Hoc Committee tasked with reflecting on the future of ISBA conferences - and please take a moment to complete the associated survey!

We also bring you news from j-ISBA, along with updates on what is happening across the broader Bayesian community. Finally, this issue features important information on teaching Bayesian statistics and celebrates the newly elected members from the most recent ISBA elections.

ISBA community, enjoy!
:::
